text=Path('source4/torture/ndr/krb5pac.c').read_text()
for name in ['PAC_DATA_data','PAC_DATA_data2','PAC_DATA_data3']:
    idx=text.index(f'static const uint8_t {name}[] = {{')
    end=text.index('};', idx)
    nums=re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}', text[idx:end])
    data=bytes(int(x,16) for x in nums)
    Path(f'/workspace/{name}.bin').write_bytes(data)
    print(name, len(data))
PY && ls -l /workspace/PAC_DATA_*.bin
